mapper.select: SELECT task_id, owner_id, kb_id, document_id, idempotency_key, task_type, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, error_summary, created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at FROM ingestion_task WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE ingestion_task SET status = #{nextStatus}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, started_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'RUNNING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER', 'CANCELLED', 'SUCCEEDED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_at END WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status = #{currentStatus}
